summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction (v2, best version). It has seven labelled vertices A–G, solid segments B–C, A–D (through G), A–B, A–F, B–F (through G), B–E, and the long line C–F extended through E and D to the measured top endpoint. The automatic Critic scored v2 at 0.95 with checklist 1.0, no issues, and must_repair=false.
